chart.title: {symbol} price

keyInfo.title: Key information
keyInfo.distributionsTitle: Read from the price history: the adjusted close parts from the quoted close whenever a distribution is paid. Observed from data, not declared by the issuer.

about.title: About
about.noDescription: No description has been saved for this security.

performance.title: Security performance
performance.subject: How the instrument itself has moved, whether or not you held it. What your own position made is under Total return.
performance.empty: Not enough price history to measure a return yet.
performance.excludesDividendsTitle: This provider supplies no adjusted-close series, so these returns are measured on price alone. For a fund that pays out, they understate the return by its yield.

positionInfo.title: Position info
positionInfo.realizedMixed: Realized in {currencies}, so not added up
positionInfo.realizedUnknownReason: This gain cannot be worked out: the position holds shares that were added with no cost, so what the sold shares cost is unknown. Open the transaction that added them and enter their price.
positionInfo.totalReturnTitle: Unrealized gain, plus what you realized on sales and received in income, less fees, over the capital you put in. A simple return on that capital: it is not annualized and does not weight tranches by how long you held them.

closed.title: Position closed
closed.description: You no longer hold this security. Its history stays available below.
closed.realizedUnknownReason: This gain cannot be worked out: the position held shares that were added with no cost, so what the sold shares cost is unknown. Open the transaction that added them and enter their price.

empty.noPositionHint: You have not recorded any transactions for this security yet.
empty.noAccounts: This security is not held in any account.

weightings.title: Breakdown
weightings.sectorEmpty: No sector breakdown is stored. Monize fills this in from the provider for funds and ETFs.
weightings.countryEmpty: No country breakdown is stored. You can enter one when editing the security.
weightings.assetClassEmpty: No asset class breakdown is stored yet.

bond.empty: You hold no series of this bond kind yet.

totals.unknownRefusal: The lots cannot be worked out, so no total is given.

lots.assumedTitle: The real purchase date is unknown: this lot arrived by a transfer with no linked sending side.

earlyRefusal.RECORD_DAY: Not redeemable on the record day

lotsRefusal.SPLIT: The lots cannot be derived: a bond does not split.
lotsRefusal.FRACTIONAL_QUANTITY: The lots cannot be derived: a quantity is not a whole number of bonds.
lotsRefusal.OVER_REMOVAL: The lots cannot be derived: more bonds were removed than were held.
lotsRefusal.INVALID_QUANTITY: The lots cannot be derived: a quantity is missing, negative or too large.
lotsRefusal.REMOVAL_EXCEEDS_SERIES: The lots cannot be derived: more bonds of one series were removed than were held.
lotsRefusal.SERIES_NOT_DETERMINED: The lots cannot be derived: the series of a purchase is not known.

lotsRefusalDetail.SPLIT: A split ({action} on {date}) is recorded on this security; a bond does not split.
lotsRefusalDetail.FRACTIONAL_QUANTITY: {action} on {date} moves {quantity} bonds, which is not a whole number.
lotsRefusalDetail.OVER_REMOVAL: {action} on {date} removes {quantity} bonds, more than were held.
lotsRefusalDetail.INVALID_QUANTITY: The quantity of {action} on {date} is missing, negative or too large.
lotsRefusalDetail.REMOVAL_EXCEEDS_SERIES: {action} on {date} removes {quantity} bonds of its series, more than were held in that series.
lotsRefusalDetail.SERIES_NOT_DETERMINED: {action} on {date} names no series, and no stored series of the bond kind was on sale that day. Fetch the series and choose it in the transaction.

assumptions.title: Projection assumptions
assumptions.latestObservation: {benchmark} assumed at {value} for every later period, the latest published value ({observation})
assumptions.supplied: {benchmark} assumed at {value} for every later period
assumptions.suppliedSimpleAnnual: {benchmark} assumed to grow {value} a year (simple annual growth, not compounded) for every later month

recompute.failed: The prices could not be recalculated.

rule.dailyFloor: The daily rate (index plus spread) is never below {floor}
rule.daily: Every day: {benchmark} + {addend}, added up per day
rule.lockout: An auction within {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}} before a period end is not used for that period

indexation.inflation: Inflation-indexed: from {date} (period 2) the rate is {benchmark} + {addend}, recalculated every period
indexation.floating: Floating rate: from {date} (period 2) the rate is {benchmark} + {addend}, recalculated every period

chart.title: Cumulative interest at each period end
chart.stoppedAt: Interest is not known from period {period}, so the chart stops before it.

scenarios.title: Inflation scenarios
scenarios.caption: Projected maturity value and interest by assumed value
scenarios.intro: Projections, not certainties: every period that has not started is assumed to follow the {benchmark} value in the first column. Known and announced periods do not change. Select a row to see its rate table and chart.
scenarios.loadFailed: The scenarios could not be loaded.
scenarios.asOfNote: Valued on {date}, the date chosen above: the figures cover the bonds held on that day.

benchmarks.US_CPI_U_NSA: CPI-U, all items, not seasonally adjusted (BLS)

valuationRefusal.PURCHASE_OUTSIDE_SALE_WINDOW: This series can only be bought from {from} to {to}. This lot was bought on {purchaseDate}, so it is not valued.
valuationRefusal.PURCHASE_AFTER_MATURITY: This series matured on {maturityDate}. This lot was bought on {purchaseDate}, on or after that day, so it is not valued.

bond.marketPriceRequired: This security holds a series that trades on a market, so its price is not a function of its terms. Monize writes no price for it: enter the price yourself. The values of the lots below are worked out from the terms and are not market values.

partial.title: This valuation is incomplete, so read the figures as partial.
partial.terms: The terms of the bond are incomplete (for example a calendar is not installed).
partial.reference: Reference data is missing; see the list of data still needed below.
partial.earlyRedemption: The early redemption terms are incomplete, so early redemption values may be missing.
partial.other: At least one lot cannot be fully valued yet (for example a rate is not known).

projectionMissing.title: Later periods cannot be projected
projectionMissing.item: {benchmark}: no value is published and no assumption is set, so later periods cannot be projected (published by {publisher})
projectionMissing.itemNoPublisher: {benchmark}: no value is published and no assumption is set, so later periods cannot be projected (publisher not known)

redemption.title: Early redemption terms
redemption.forfeitAccrued: On early redemption, the interest accrued in the current period is forfeited.
redemption.floorAllPeriods: In every period, the fee never reduces the proceeds below the face value.
redemption.floorFirstPeriod: In the first period only, the fee cannot reduce the proceeds below the face value; from the second period the full fee is deducted.
